name: VeriQloud
description: VeriQloud develops software and protocols for secure quantum communication networks, including quantum key distribution and cloud-based quantum computing access. The company contributes to the FranceQCI national quantum communication infrastructure project and offers HyQloud, a full-stack solution for hybrid classical-quantum cloud datacenters.

products.name: HyQloud
products.description: Full-stack solution for hybrid classical-quantum cloud datacenters with secure quantum communication protocols

products.name: Quantum Key Distribution Software
products.description: Software and protocols for secure quantum communication networks including QKD implementation

highlights: Contributor to FranceQCI national quantum communication infrastructure project
Pioneer in quantum-secure cloud computing access since 2015

sources.title: VeriQloud Secures EUR 1.9 Million Investment from Quantonation and WinEquity

news.title: VeriQloud Secures €1.9 Million Investment from Quantonation and WinEquity
news.excerpt: VeriQloud raised €1.9 million in a funding round led by Quantonation and joined by WinEquity. The capital will enable VeriQloud to accelerate the development of its hardware and software solutions for quantum communication networks.
